m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read the g2 implementer handoff at .agent-work/w2-basis/crew-handoffs/g2-implementer-handoff.md, docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md's Basis subsection, and scripts/checklist_engine.py's _resolve_basis_locator to confirm the exact shipped basis shape. Verify handoff completeness (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Confirm the shipped template and both overlay copies are byte-identical before starting (stop condition). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff read and complete; basis shape confirmed against docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md and checklist_engine.py source; overlay/baseline pre-edit identity confirmed
postconditions.satisfied_by: Handoff read in full; verified complete. Basis shape confirmed against docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md + _resolve_basis_locator source. Overlay/baseline pre-edit identity confirmed via diff (no drift).

m1-red-test.title: TDD red: write the integration test against the pre-edit template
m1-red-test.imperative: In tests/test_checklist_engine.py, add a new test class (e.g. CommanderSpineBasisFields) pinned to the current git HEAD SHA, asserting plan.c2/c4/c5 in the shipped COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json each carry a well-formed basis object of the confirmed shape, every other condition carries no basis key, and a live checklist built from the shipped template renders the basis: sub-line at plan.c2/c4/c5 when active. Run it against the PRE-EDIT template and observe it fail (fields do not exist yet). Attest c1 (manual, red observed) -- do NOT make this a command check (would need to pass, contradicting red).

postconditions.statement: new test class written, pinned to HEAD SHA, run against pre-edit template and observed to fail with the expected reason (missing basis key)
postconditions.satisfied_by: New class CommanderSpineBasisFields added to tests/test_checklist_engine.py, pinned to HEAD 9d5aac6daa58a72fc6a665cb39879ee5705f7f71. Run against the pre-edit template: 5 failures (2 whole tests + 3 subtests) -- test_plan_c2_c4_c5_each_carry_the_ratified_basis_shape fails all 3 subtests (basis is None for c2/c4/c5), test_no_condition_outside_plan_c2_c4_c5_carries_a_basis_key fails (found [] vs expected [plan.c2,c4,c5]), test_live_checklist_from_the_template_renders_basis_lines_at_plan fails (no basis: lines rendered). RED confirmed.

constraints: do not touch any condition other than plan.c2/c4/c5
hand-edit only, never json.load/json.dump round-trip the template

m2-green-edit.title: TDD green: surgically edit the template, sync overlays, full suite passes
m2-green-edit.imperative: Surgically insert the basis sibling key into plan.c2, plan.c4, plan.c5 in skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json (text edit only, no json.load/json.dump round-trip). Re-validate with a read-only json.load parse-check. Sync .agent-work/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json and .agent-work/templates/.baseline/constellation-commander/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json to be byte-identical. Run the full tests/test_checklist_engine.py suite and confirm the new test now passes along with every pre-existing test. Confirm the shipped template is still accepted by any install-time validator that independently parses it, if one exists.

preconditions.statement: red test written and observed failing
preconditions.satisfied_by: red test written and observed failing (see m1-red-test.c1 evidence)

postconditions.statement: full test_checklist_engine.py suite passes, including the new red-proof test now green

check.command: env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_PARENT python -m pytest -q tests/test_checklist_engine.py

constraints: exactly 3 conditions edited: plan.c2, plan.c4, plan.c5
overlay + baseline copies byte-identical to shipped file after edit

payload.cmd: env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_PARENT python -m pytest -q tests/test_checklist_engine.py

why_trail.why: surgical text edit inserted basis on plan.c2/c4/c5 only (confirmed via git diff: exactly those 3 lines changed); overlays synced and byte-identical; full suite green at 514 passed/148 subtests (up from baseline 511/145, exactly +3 tests +3 subtests); no install-time schema validator exists to re-check (install_constellation.py only checks template file existence)
